rows.Question text: Do you, or does anyone in your household, work in any of the following industries?
rows.Response list (codes):
1 Market research or advertising
2 Food or beverage manufacturing
3 Grocery retail
4 Journalism or media
99 None of these [EXCLUSIVE]
rows.Base / logic / checks:
ASK ALL
RANDOMIZE codes 1-4
TERMINATE (T01) if any of codes 1, 2 or 3 is selected. Code 4 on its own continues.

ASK ALL
TERMINATE (T02) if under 18 or over 64.
Create hidden hAGE: 1 = 18-34, 2 = 35-49, 3 = 50-64.

rows.Question text: Which best describes your role in grocery shopping for your household?
rows.Response list (codes):
1 I do all or most of it
2 I share it equally with someone else
3 Someone else does most of it

rows.Question text: Which of these types of snack have you bought in the past 3 months?
rows.Response list (codes):
1 Cereal or granola bars
2 Protein bars
3 Crisps or chips
4 Biscuits or cookies
5 Fruit snacks
99 None of these [EXCLUSIVE]
rows.Base / logic / checks:
ASK ALL
RANDOMIZE codes 1-5
Must select code 1 or code 2 to continue; otherwise TERMINATE (T04).

5 Less often
rows.Base / logic / checks:

TERMINATE (T04) if code 5.
